mapper.sql: conversion_id, object_type, object_id, file_no, source_file_name, source_file_path, source_size_bytes, source_sha256, output_file_name, output_file_path, output_size_bytes, output_sha256, status_cd, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, claim_token, claimed_at, claim_expires_at, started_at, completed_at, current_yn, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: WITH logical_file_lock AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended( CONCAT_WS(CHR(31), CAST(#{objectType} AS text), CAST(#{objectId} AS text), CAST(#{fileNo} AS text)), CAST(0 AS bigint))) AS lock_acquired ), superseded AS ( UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET current_yn = FALSE, status_cd = CASE WHEN status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') THEN status_cd ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') THEN completed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM logical_file_lock WHERE object_type = #{objectType} AND object_id = #{objectId} AND file_no = #{fileNo} AND current_yn = TRUE AND source_sha256 <> LOWER(#{sourceSha256}) RETURNING 1 ), supersede_barrier AS ( SELECT logical_file_lock.lock_acquired, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superseded) AS superseded_count FROM logical_file_lock ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO docs_pdf_conversion ( conversion_id, object_type, object_id, file_no, source_file_name, source_file_path, source_size_bytes, source_sha256, status_cd, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, current_yn ) SELECT CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid), #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{fileNo}, #{sourceFileName}, #{sourceFilePath}, #{sourceSizeBytes}, LOWER(#{sourceSha256}), 'PENDING', 0, GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{maxAttempts}, 0), 3), 1), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TRUE FROM supersede_barrier ON CONFLICT (object_type, object_id, file_no, source_sha256) DO UPDATE SET source_file_name = EXCLUDED.source_file_name, source_file_path = EXCLUDED.source_file_path, source_size_bytes = EXCLUDED.source_size_bytes, max_attempts = GREATEST( EXCLUDED.max_attempts, CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND docs_pdf_conversion.output_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN docs_pdf_conversion.attempt_count WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.attempt_count ELSE 1 END), current_yn = TRUE, status_cd = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND docs_pdf_conversion.output_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PENDING' END, attempt_count = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND docs_pdf_conversion.output_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN docs_pdf_conversion.attempt_count WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.attempt_count ELSE 0 END, next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND docs_pdf_conversion.output_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN docs_pdf_conversion.next_attempt_at WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.next_attempt_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, claim_token = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.claim_token ELSE NULL END, claimed_at = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.claimed_at ELSE NULL END, claim_expires_at = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN docs_pdf_conversion.claim_expires_at ELSE NULL END, started_at = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED', 'PROCESSING') THEN docs_pdf_conversion.started_at ELSE NULL END, completed_at = CASE WHEN docs_pdf_conversion.status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND docs_pdf_conversion.output_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN docs_pdf_conversion.completed_at ELSE NULL END, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING docs_pdf_conversion.* ) SELECT FROM upserted
SELECT FROM docs_pdf_conversion WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid)

SELECT FROM docs_pdf_conversion WHERE source_sha256 = LOWER(#{sourceSha256}) AND status_cd IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'NOT_REQUIRED') AND output_file_path IS NOT NULL AND output_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND output_size_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY current_yn DESC, completed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT conversion_id::text FROM docs_pdf_conversion WHERE current_yn = TRUE AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( (status_cd = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, conversion_id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH claimed AS ( UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, claim_token = CAST(#{claimToken} AS uuid), claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, claim_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (GREATEST(CAST(#{leaseSeconds} AS integer), 1) * INTERVAL '1 second'), started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), completed_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND current_yn = TRUE AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( (status_cd = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) RETURNING docs_pdf_conversion.* ) SELECT FROM claimed

WITH failed AS ( UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = 'FAILED', claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(last_error), '') IS NULL THEN 'Conversion worker lease expired after all attempts were exhausted.' ELSE last_error END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE current_yn = TRUE AND status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND attempt_count >= max_attempts RETURNING docs_pdf_conversion.* ) SELECT FROM failed
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = 'SUCCEEDED', output_file_name = #{outputFileName}, output_file_path = #{outputFilePath}, output_size_bytes = #{outputSizeBytes}, output_sha256 = LOWER(#{outputSha256}), claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = CAST(#{claimToken} AS uuid)

UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = CASE WHEN attempt_count < max_attempts THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (GREATEST(CAST(#{retryDelaySeconds} AS integer), 0) * INTERVAL '1 second'), claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count < max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 2000), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = CAST(#{claimToken} AS uuid)

UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = 'FAILED', claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 2000), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = CAST(#{claimToken} AS uuid)

UPDATE docs_pdf_conversion SET status_cd = 'NOT_REQUIRED', output_file_name = #{outputFileName}, output_file_path = #{outputFilePath}, output_size_bytes = #{outputSizeBytes}, output_sha256 = LOWER(#{outputSha256}), claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversion_id = CAST(#{conversionId} AS uuid) AND current_yn = TRUE AND ( status_cd = 'PENDING' OR (status_cd = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = CAST(#{claimToken} AS uuid)) )
